source_text: Blue Mini Jouster "Known to flourish in the rainy season, this insect is drawn to “Unlike its gold counterpart, the blue mini jouster takes a leisurely pace when jabbing its opponent’s eyeballs.” Quest: Egg Wave Mount Hyjal --

name: Gold Mini Jouster
source_text: Gold Mini Jouster “This critter is infamous for its ability to unleash a fast and furious eyeball jabbing.” Quest: Egg Wave Mount Hyjal --

name: Personal World Destroyer
source_text: Personal World Destroyer “Goblin engineering at its finest, Blueprints based on the massive fel reaver in Hellfire Penninsula.” Profession: Engineering -- --

name: De-Weaponized Mechanical Companion
source_text: De-Weaponized Mechanical Companion “The gold standard for sturdy gnomish design, this mechanical critter is the perfect companion for the lonely engineer on the go.” Profession: Engineering -- --

name: Crawling Claw
source_text: Crawling Claw “This appears to be nothing more than the paw of a small primate. A closer inspection shows that the hand has been dried by centuries of exposure to the sands of Uldum.” Profession: Archeology -- --

name: Pebble
source_text: Pebble “An adventurous little elemental, Pebble escaped hungry gyreworms in the Crumbling Depths, braved the emptiness of the Twisting Nether, and ultimately found himself rescued from a mailbox.” Achievement: Rock Lover Deepholm --

name: Fossilized Hatchling
source_text: Fossilized Hatchling “You stare at her, and she just stares right back. So clever; sometimes it seems as if she’s figuring out how to open doors.” Profession: Archeology -- --

name: Enchanted Lantern
source_text: Enchanted Lantern “Reduces the likelihood of being eaten by monsters when you enter pitch-black places.” Profession: Cataclysm Enchanting -- --

name: Rustberg Gull
source_text: Rustberg Gull “This bird is a salty veteran of the endless naval battles surrounding Tol Barad—a veteran whose grown plump from picking through the leftovers, that is.” Vendor: Quartermaster Brazie Tol Barad Peninsula Faction: Baradin’s Warden’s-Honored/ Hellscream’s Reach- Honored 50 Tol Barad Commendations

name: Clockwork Gnome
source_text: Clockwork Gnome “Thought to be an original construct of the titans, the Clockwork gnome has some gears smaller than the eye can see.” Profession: Archeology -- --

name: Fox Kit
source_text: Fox Kit “The fighting in Tol Barad has made it difficult to find these kits, and numerous would-be owners have decimated the fox population there as a result.” Drop: Baradin Fox Tol Barad Peninsula --

name: Tiny Shale Spider
source_text: Tiny Shale Spider “The elemental shale spider is no true arachnid, but it has durability and ferocity that make it feared even in Deepholm.” Drop: Jadefang Deepholm --

name: Magic Lamp
source_text: Magic Lamp “Higitus figi-hockity pocki-abracadab-prestidig—oh, pinfeathers!” Profession: Enchanting -- --

source_text: Hyjal Bear Cub “The cubs of Hyjal suffered much during the Cataclysm. On the bright side, the devastation also led to their newfound love of heights and daredevil stunts.” Vendor: Varlan Highbough Molten Front 1,500 Gold

name: Mac Frog
source_text: Mac Frog “Flamboyantly colored and more exuberant than most frogs.” Pet Battle Uldum --

name: Locust
source_text: Locust “When the locusts swarm, you can hear nothing but the sound of their wings.” Pet Battle Uldum --

name: Oasis Moth
source_text: Oasis Moth “Prefers to dwell along desert streams, wells or watering holes and feed on Whiptail nectar.” Pet Battle Uldum --

name: Leopard Scorpid
source_text: Leopard Scorpid “Loves to rest inside footwear of unsuspecting travelers during the night.” Pet Battle Uldum --

name: Tol'vir Scarab
source_text: Tol’vir Scarab “Carrion feeders often found in large numbers within ancient unearthed tombs; they can survive long periods of time without feeding.” Pet Battle Uldum --

name: Highlands Mouse
source_text: Highlands Mouse "The mice of the highlands, perhaps twisted by the Twilight’s Hammer are aggressive and fight for dominance between each other.” Pet Battle Twilight Highlands --

name: Crimson Shale Hatchling
source_text: Crimson Shale Hatchling “Through experimentation, the mages of Dalaran have discovered that the powered remains of a crimson shale spider will greatly increase the conflagration of their fire spells.” Pet Battle Deepholm --

name: Deepholm Cockroach
source_text: Deepholm Cockroach “The cockroaches of Deepholm can burrow into stone itself to make their nests.” Pet Battle Deepholm --

name: Crystal Beetle
source_text: Crystal Beetle “A cousin to the Twilight Beetle, this insect has learned to feed on crystals which resonate with ancient energies.” Pet Battle Deepholm --

name: Crimson Geode
source_text: Crimson Geode “Therazane wore these spunky crimson elementals as jewelry before the azure craze swept through Deepholm.” Pet Battle Deepholm --

name: Highlands Turkey
source_text: Highlands Turkey “Capable of flying, unlike domesticated types.” Pet Battle Twilight Highlands --

name: Fungal Moth
source_text: Fungal Moth “Prefers to dwell in dark caves and feed on Heartblossom nectar.” Pet Battle Deepholm --

name: Highlands Skunk

name: Emerald Shale Hatchling
source_text: Emerald Shale Hatchling “Adventurers have reported rare sightings of a monstrous sized emerald shale spider, which the denizens of Deepholm have come to call the Jadefang.” Pet Battle Deepholm --

name: Amethyst Shale Hatchling
source_text: Amethyst Shale Hatchling “Adult amethyst shale spiders prefer to create their nests against the outer walls of Deepholm.” Pet Battle Deepholm, Desolace --

name: Faceless Minion
source_text: Faceless Minion "Hedgehogs are not all fond of croquet nor flamingos." Pet Battles Dread Wastes --

name: Drafty
source_text: Drafty “If you feel a slight gust that made you shiver, that was probably Drafty.” Drop: Nezir Throne of the Four Winds --

name: Blazehound
source_text: Blazehound “Some say it’s the pup of Riplimb and Rageface, others say, ‘I don’t want to think about that.’” Drop: Shannox Firelands --

name: Cinderweb Recluse
source_text: Cinderweb Recluse "The glow emanating from these is both calming and eerie at the same time when in total darkness." Drop: Beth’tilac Firelands --

name: Infernal Pyreclaw
source_text: Infernal Pyreclaw “During his time in the Firelands Fandral would often grow bored and work shaping magic on the local flora and fauna.” Drop: Majordomo Staghelm Firelands --
